16: A hostile crew shouts a warning and gives the player a moment before the first shot, may knock before it enters a base, and may stop him for a few questions and a toll. Off means kill on sight: no warning, no grace, no toll question, and a hold-up never starts. On means this crew always warns, except in a raid. Raid crews, assassins and ambushers ship Off, and raids, assassinations and highway ambushes are kill on sight whatever a crew's setting. The Warning sandbox settings give an Off crew a chance to warn anyway and put a time limit on every warning.

28: How this NPC treats zombies. Inherit keeps the standard caution: detour or wait when a crowd stands on the route, leave a zombie alone while on a mission, fight it when it attacks. On avoids zombies harder: waits or detours for a single one and fights only when attacked. Off fights zombies on sight: no travel waits or detours, and guns are never held back.
29: Inherit and On keep the standard gun discipline: a gun user may leave the gun stowed and use a melee weapon, a rifle-butt shove or walk past a zombie. Off makes this NPC use the weapon it holds against zombies: no holding fire, no switch to melee, no shove at point blank. Ammo-out and reload swaps stay.
